Write $F=xy+yz+zx-2xyz$. Since $xyz\le xy$ and $xyz\le xz$, we have $F\ge yz\ge0$.

Expanding and using the sum condition gives
$$4F-1=(1-2x)(1-2y)(1-2z).$$
If one variable exceeds $1/2$, exactly one factor is negative and the others nonnegative, so $F\le1/4<7/27$. Otherwise all three factors are nonnegative and their sum is one. AM–GM bounds their product by $1/27$, yielding $F\le(1+1/27)/4=7/27$. The upper bound is attained at $x=y=z=1/3$, and the lower at $(1,0,0)$ and its permutations.
